description: The Sprites REPORTERS half, and the name now says what the fixture pins: `new_turtle`/`who`/`turtles` are reserved WITHOUT the Sprites profile. All three `define`s raise `ol-reserved-word` under `core-language` alone. Keeping reporters separate from the block-heads (`reserved-procedures-without-sprites`) is deliberate: they reach the built-in-names predicate as registered PRIMITIVES rather than as keywords, so a change that fixed one category and missed the other would still turn this fixture red. HISTORY: issue #746 wrote it as the OFF half of a profile gate, expecting three clean declarations; `spec/grammar.md:408` and ruling #833 retracted that gate, and issue #841 removed it from the checker -- the expectation is flipped rather than the fixture deleted, so the behaviour stays pinned across the reversal. `"check": true`: checker diagnostics only, nothing executes.
